scripts.check: bun run check:tools && bun run format:check && bun run check:source-boundary && bun run check:extraction && bun run check:records && bun run check:docs && bun run check:version-axis && bun run check:schema-origin && bun run check:core-release && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:portable && bun run build:portable
scripts.check:tools: set -e; for tool in git go gofmt node; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { printf 'Required portable check tool is missing: %s\n' "$tool" >&2; exit 127; }; done; test -x node_modules/.bin/wrangler || { printf 'Run bun install --frozen-lockfile before check; pinned Wrangler is missing.\n' >&2; exit 127; }
scripts.check:version-axis: node --check scripts/version-axis.mjs && bun test scripts/version-axis.test.mjs && bun scripts/version-axis.mjs
scripts.check:schema-origin: set -e; node --check scripts/schema-origin-projection.mjs scripts/schema-origin-deploy.mjs scripts/schema-tool-closure.mjs; bun test scripts/schema-origin-projection.test.mjs scripts/schema-origin-deploy.test.mjs; node scripts/schema-origin-projection.mjs --check; output_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$output_dir"' EXIT; node_modules/.bin/wrangler versions upload --dry-run --outdir "$output_dir" --config schema-origin/wrangler.jsonc >/dev/null
scripts.check:core-release: node --check scripts/core-release.mjs scripts/deploy.mjs scripts/sealed-deploy-launcher.mjs scripts/sealed-deploy-bootstrap.mjs scripts/sealed-deploy-runner.mjs && bun test scripts/core-release.test.mjs scripts/deploy.test.mjs && go test ./release/broker
scripts.format:check: set -e; unformatted="$(gofmt -l .)"; if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then printf 'The following files need gofmt:\n%s\n' "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi
scripts.build:portable: set -e; build_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT; go build -o "$build_dir/" ./...
